title: dspy
summary: DSPy is a framework for programming Large Language Models (LLMs) by composing modules, optimizing prompts and weights, and evaluating performance. It enables developers to build robust, efficient, and adaptable LLM-powered applications by moving beyond manual prompt engineering to systematic program optimization. Users define tasks, build multi-step programs, and then automatically compile them for improved accuracy and cost-effectiveness.

nodes.label: Developer / User
nodes.title: Human User
nodes.description: The primary actor who designs, builds, optimizes, and evaluates DSPy programs to solve complex tasks with Language Models.

nodes.label: Define LLM Tasks & Program Structure
nodes.title: Core DSPy Program Building
nodes.description: Establishes the foundational architecture for building and optimizing Language Model programs, defining core program structures, and managing task definitions via signatures.

nodes.label: Handle Structured Data & Adapters
nodes.title: Structured Data & LM Adapters
nodes.description: Provides a flexible framework for defining custom data types and adapters, enabling DSPy to seamlessly interact with Language Models and handle diverse structured and unstructured data formats.

nodes.label: Integrate & Execute External Tools
nodes.title: LLM Tooling & Sandboxing
nodes.description: Provides core primitives for integrating and executing external tools within a sandboxed environment, enabling LLMs to interact with dynamic data and functions.

nodes.label: Manage LLM Communication
nodes.title: Language Model Integration Layer
nodes.description: Centralizes all functionalities for interacting with Language Models, providing core client interfaces, caching, streaming, and provider-specific integrations for various LLM services.

nodes.label: Implement Prediction & Retrieval
nodes.title: Advanced Prediction & Retrieval
nodes.description: Encompasses advanced strategies for generating predictions (agentic behaviors, iterative refinement) and diverse retrieval mechanisms for fetching relevant information to augment LLM responses.

nodes.label: External LLMs & APIs
nodes.title: Third-Party LLMs & Services
nodes.description: Represents the actual external Language Models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, local LLMs) and other APIs or services that DSPy programs interact with.

nodes.label: Optimize & Evaluate Programs
nodes.title: Program Optimization & Evaluation
nodes.description: Provides advanced teleprompters (optimizers) for DSPy programs, along with tools for evaluating their performance and proposing optimized instructions.

nodes.label: Provide Training/Evaluation Data
nodes.title: DSPy Dataset Management
nodes.description: Tools for loading, processing, and managing various datasets for DSPy programs, including specialized datasets and utilities for data splitting and sampling.

nodes.label: Define Evaluation Metrics
nodes.title: DSPy Evaluation Metrics
nodes.description: Provides a suite of metrics for evaluating DSPy programs, including traditional exact-match/F1 scores and advanced LLM-based metrics for semantic F1, completeness, and groundedness.

nodes.label: Propose Program Instructions
nodes.title: DSPy Program Proposers
nodes.description: Tools for analyzing datasets and language model programs, generating observations, and proposing optimized instructions for individual modules within a program.

nodes.label: Monitor Optimization Progress
nodes.title: DSPy Optimization Utilities
nodes.description: Helper functions for monitoring and evaluating program optimization trials, including inspecting model execution history, logging token usage, and calculating program quality over time.

nodes.label: General System Utilities
nodes.title: General DSPy Utilities
nodes.description: A collection of general-purpose utilities for file downloading, asynchronous program execution, callback management, and adapting async modules for synchronous use.

nodes.label: Generate Documentation
nodes.title: Documentation Generation Tools
nodes.description: Provides various utilities for generating and enhancing documentation, including scripts for API reference creation, MkDocs navigation updates, and client-side features.

groups.label: Program Construction & Data Flow
groups.title: Build LLM Programs & Manage Data
groups.description: This group focuses on how users define their LLM tasks, structure their programs using DSPy modules, and handle diverse data types and external tools for input and output.

groups.label: LLM Interaction & Strategies
groups.title: Communicate with LLMs & Apply Strategies
groups.description: This group covers the core mechanisms for interacting with Language Models, implementing advanced prediction and retrieval strategies, and managing LLM clients, caching, and streaming.

groups.label: Optimization & Evaluation
groups.title: Improve & Measure LLM Program Performance
groups.description: This group provides the advanced teleprompters (optimizers) for automatically enhancing DSPy programs, along with comprehensive tools for evaluating their performance against datasets and metrics.

groups.label: Supporting Utilities
groups.title: General System & Documentation Utilities
groups.description: This group offers general-purpose utilities for file operations, asynchronous execution, and callback management, alongside tools for generating and enhancing DSPy's documentation.
